tasks.text: Block-based programming is playful and easy.
Scratch helps you learn to code.
Sprites are the characters in our program.
The green flag starts our creation.
You can change the Sprite's look with costumes.
X and Y coordinates determine the position.
Blocks must be dragged into the script area.
Condition checking is done with the If block.
Create your own animation with blocks!
